metaTitle: Custom Poly Propylene Coffee Mugs | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom poly propylene coffee mugs in bulk. Durable, lightweight, and perfect for branding. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Poly propylene coffee mugs offer a lightweight, shatter-resistant alternative to ceramic or glass, making them ideal for outdoor events, job sites, or corporate giveaways where durability matters. The 12 oz Harvest Mug and 16 oz Stir'n Sip Mug™ are popular choices for full-color imprinting with your logo, ensuring your brand stays visible during coffee breaks on the go.
heroAltText: Custom poly propylene coffee mugs with logo imprint in assorted colors, stackable and durable
